Bhai, maine check kiya hai. Aapka order (ORD-22005) abhi bhi "in transit" hai aur Delhivery carrier ke paas hai. Iski expected delivery date **12 September 2026** dikha rahi hai.

Main samajh sakta hoon ki aapko kaam ke liye iski bahut zaroorat hai aur itna lamba delay hona galat hai. Kya aap chahte hain ki main iska refund initiate kar doon ya phir main isko human agent ke paas escalate karoon taaki delivery jaldi se jaldi ho sake?
